description: Get scheduled macro/economic events (CPI, FOMC, jobs reports, GDP, etc.) between two dates. Optionally filter to a single country (ISO-3166 alpha-2, e.g. "US"). Defaults to US when omitted. One call covers at most 366 days: a longer window is shortened to that span and the response says so in windowClamped.

limit.description: Max events returned (default 100, max 500); the response's total counts every match.

to.description: End date inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD), on or after from and at most 366 days after it

name: get_economic_calendar
title: Get Economic Calendar
